stages.discovery: A traveling merchant's storefront has been set up just off the road, shutters open and stock arranged on the shelves - but no one's minding it. A ledger sits open on the counter, pen still resting in the crease, as if the shopkeeper stepped away mid-sentence and simply never came back.

choices.label: Leave Coin and Take What You Need
choices.description: Pay honestly even with no one watching
choices.outcome: You count out fair coin and leave it in the strongbox before taking a few useful supplies off the shelf. If the merchant ever comes back, at least the books will square.

choices.label: Read the Ledger
choices.description: Maybe it says where the merchant went - Investigation check

check.success_outcome: The last entries are ordinary - stock counts, a customer's name, a note to restring the shop's bell. Whatever pulled the merchant away, it wasn't written down beforehand.
check.failure_outcome: The handwriting is cramped and hurried, and you can't make sense of more than a few scattered stock numbers.

choices.label: Leave the Shop as You Found It
choices.description: ESC also cancels - it isn't yours to pick through
choices.outcome: You leave the shelves untouched and the ledger open to the same page, in case the merchant still means to return to it.
